title: paintingpack1~ Junimocore
description: set of paintings semi based off the junimocore aesthetic
body: First resource pack!!!Anways, this pack is the first of many i plan to do focusing on paintings, this time with a junimocore theme. You may have noticed some images that come from a manga called phantom busters (its really good btw ദ്ദി◝ ⩊ ◜.ᐟ) if they arent your cup of tea, open or extract the resource pack, then find any specific paintings youd like to change. set the same and resolution of your images to match, then replace my images and it should work!~Have a lovely day or night~
